title: Explicit separation of quadratic irrationals from the middle-third Cantor set
summary: An earlier form of this manuscript claimed, subject to a ``shallow contribution'' hypothesis, a log-square upper bound for the first occurrence of the ternary digit $1$ in a quadratic irrational, and consequently a quantitative separation from the middle-third Cantor set. Those conclusions are withdrawn.
